name: Real Embedding Adapter
objective: Implement a real or adapter-ready embedding interface that can replace deterministic hash similarity with provider-backed or local embedding vectors while preserving offline fallback.
why_now: P18-P21 exposed runtime status, monitoring, dashboard artifacts and deterministic compression. P22 should upgrade semantic retrieval quality by introducing a real embedding adapter interface without breaking offline operation.
must_not_create: external paid calls without explicit config
success_conditions: real provider hook defined but disabled by default
vault embedding index can consume adapter
no secrets or API keys required
